description: This file contains shell script code for testing various scenarios of 'git config' command behavior, including setup, checks, and multiple test cases for configuration key manipulations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a git config with a section and key.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that a specific section.key has the expected value.

methods.name: check_regex
methods.description: Verifies that a section.key matching a regex has the expected value.

methods.name: setup_many
methods.description: Sets up a git config with many entries for testing bulk operations.
